To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a novel layer for acoustic modeling is proposed, which is simultaneously recurrent, convolutional, and operates on short-term features, and that this layer outperforms other acoustic models on a 50-hour English broadcast news task.

the proposed layer is a good choice for acoustic modeling in automatic speech recognition, and that the proposed layer can be stacked with other neural network layers to improve recognition performance.

a bidirectional gated unit that uses convolution for the gating units performs well in acoustic modeling, that it outperforms bidirectional gated recurrent and convolutional units, that the convolutional gated unit is complementary to bidirectional gated recurrent layers, and that the combination of both architectures achieves the best performance.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a novel layer which is simultaneously recurrent, convolutional and gated, and which is suitable for acoustic modeling.
the development of novel neural network architectures that are capable of processing long-term features in an efficient way.
the following questions: How to combine convolutional and recurrent neural networks in a single unified layer?

the proposed architecture outperforms other models on the 50 hour task, and that the proposed architecture is more robust to the number of stacked bidirectional gated units.
the proposed bidirectional gated recurrent convolutional unit is an efficient acoustic modeling unit, and can be used as a drop-in replacement for bidirectional gated recurrent neural network units.
our proposed layer is an interesting and promising alternative for modeling acoustic features.

the proposed layer is a promising alternative for the recurrent and convolutional layers used for acoustic modeling.
our unified model is a promising candidate for acoustic modeling in automatic speech recognition.

the proposed layer is a powerful and efficient building block for deep recurrent convolutional networks.
